rules: no stubs / shells / tied ports: an input without a real producer stays undriven and is listed in a gap
on-die edges fixed-slot: ready_or_credit only with allowed_exception at the HBM PHY/controller boundary
clock/reset ports are bound to hb_ckgen domain outputs (die CTS / staged reset tree build the trees)
off-die pins (SerDes/UCIe PMA, refclk, por_n) are die top-level ports

host_N.note: host UCIe-A macro. tx/rx/st edges belong to region host_misc (host_cp ingress/loader). Host side must drive tx[511:0] and consume rx[511:0] + st[1:0] (link clk domain); host_cp_ingress (ot_hbm_host_static_ingress) is an AXI-lite 32-b slave, so a 512-b beat <-> AXI-lite host packet bridge is needed between them (host_misc).

host_cp_ep_face.note: pin-register face of the host link endpoint; lifted from hfd_lk_ep (wires-only wrapper, HARD_CLOCKS=1 so face clock = clk_face) as instantiated by hfd_host_native u_endpoint

host_cp_ep.note: host link endpoint core (CRC/replay 545, link-level credit at the off-die host boundary, HANDOFF 0az); params exactly as hfd_lk_ep instantiates it

notes.coll_idx_link: MASTER CHOICE: hb_coll_<q> rebound from v15 ot_hfd_coll_q{3,2}_static (V1) to ot_hfd_coll_q{3,2}_static_host_v4 #(QID) -- the H-COLL production parent (tb_hgi_coll_sw_slice_parent PASS on main, writer v4 CLOSED inside, state lanes adopted by grants v7). Reasons: (a) its HOST F20 programme target binds the 4 v15 UNBOUND control ports (qid/hgi_start/hgi_start_pc/program_cfg) to real RTL (host_cp_ingress = ot_hbm_host_static_ingress, same port names/widths) and turns qid into a QID parameter; (b) its 612-b pin frame is what the grant COLL_EP windows (1224 b = 2x612) and compact.graph provenance ('tx/rx_pin_flit 1836 = 3 x 612') already assume; (c) all v15 hb_coll edges (vm rq/rr/kq, pr ring) keep their ports and widths. Grants slot cells still say ot_hfd_coll_q{3,2}_static -> H-DIE must re-cell coll_<q> (unclosed cluster, top-down pins) and the writer/state child paths become hb_coll_<q>/u_q/u_q/{u_writer,u_ring...} (host_v4 u_q -> q*_static_v4 u_q -> q_static_v4). Did NOT pick *_elastic_rx(_pingpong): they put the 0az off-die elastic RX inside COLL and add 19-28 rx_* boundary-control inputs with no producer, while the ep plan (el1013-lkep-split.log) puts the elastic pingpong in the ep tile; owner must decide the home (G-CIL-EP). If the coordinator prefers to stay on v15 V1 masters: drop the 36 host_cp_ingress edges, restore qid as a STRAP (SW0 SE1 NW2 NE3) and gap hgi_start/hgi_start_pc/program_cfg, pin flits 596/link. host_cp_ingress TARGET_MASK (default 1<<48) must include targets 52..55 (COLL quadrants) -- host_misc sets that param; launch_v is a broadcast (all 4 quadrants start the same record). EP: no ep_* instance is emitted (no master on main); coll links <-> lk_* stay a gap; nothing aliased. lk_* clk/rst and host_N clk/rst put on the LINK domain (pll_link / por_link, ot_pdie_serdes rst is active-low despite its name, file header line 21); coll clk_link stays STREAM as in v15 (the capture endpoint runs on the native edge) -> the stream<->link crossing must live in the future ep (or pll_link must equal stream; doubt). pma_* ports are die pins (die_pins list; pma_rck/pma_tck are pad clocks of the far die / to the far die). IDX: hb_idx stays one die instance; idx_s0..3/idx_sel/idx_link/idx_q/idx_op are its hardened children placed as plan blocks. hb_argmax kept but has NO compact660_v5 slot. Accounting: every input bit of the 16 instances is an edge dst, a clock/reset, a die pin, a gap, or a kept v15 edge (hb_coll vm_rr/pr_cw_i/pr_ccw_i; hb_idx vm_rr/cr/argmax_rq; hb_argmax vm_rr/cr).
notes.host_misc:
HOST: a real UCIe->AXI-lite bridge exists on main: hfd_host_native (rtl/hbm_accel/io_native_20261014) = ot_pdie_ucie + hfd_lk_ep (CRC/replay endpoint) + ot_hbm_host_landing256 (2 x 256x256 SRAM) + ot_hbm_host_packet (packet engine, AXI-lite master s_*), joined to ot_hbm_host_static_ingress in hfd_host_static_native_qdq_program. It is lifted leaf-by-leaf: host_N (the granted ot_pdie_ucie macro) + host_cp_ep_face/host_cp_ep (hfd_lk_ep is a wires-only wrapper over inout die buses, lifted to its two leaves) + host_cp_landing + host_cp_packet in the host_cp window + host_cp_ingress. hfd_host_native's glue (6-bit tx credit counter, zero pads, pad_fault, fault concat) has no die home -> gaps G-HOST-TXCREDIT / G-HOST-PAD / G-STATUS; session id has no producer (G-HOST-SESSION); the loader service face of the packet engine (h_*/h_dma_*/m_*/irq/fault) belonged to the retired dynamic loader/CP (G-HOST-LOADERFACE).
Clock family: hfd_host_native and the ingress README both require ONE synchronous family from PHY digital side to programme targets (no CDC exists); the granted host_cp_ingress slot is clock_domain stream, so every host instance incl. host_N.clk is put on stream. If the coordinator wants host_N on link, a real CDC between endpoint and ingress is missing (doubt).
AXI-lite valid/ready between host_cp_packet and host_cp_ingress is treated as part of the off-die host boundary (README: "host elasticity ends at configuration writes"); nothing after the ingress uses ready/credit.
LOADER: only target 48 (QDQ NW, hb_quant_NW) matches the ingress frame exactly and is bound (9 edges, basis hfd_host_static_native_qdq_program + v15 required_owner "host/CP loader (NW target 48)"). VM calendars, svc groups, SFU, IDX, COLL, ARGMAX, SU need target ids / collars / adapters (G-HOST-LOADER-*). ot_vms_calendar_host_static was examined and rejected (depends on retired CP doorbell/passthrough, shadows F20-F2c). Readiness aggregate absent (G-HOST-READY).
QUANT: hb_quant_NW (ot_hgi_qdq_host_static RL7 WC4 COMPACT1) KEPT; split leaves granted but no parent composition on main (G-QUANT-SPLIT). v15 VM edges quant_vm_rq/rr/wq stand.
DMA: hb_dbk_<q> master changed to grants-v7 ot_hgi_dma_back_static_vp4_banks (STK SW0 SE1 NW2 NE3, same as grant params), v15 rq/rr edges stand; command + WB-band ports gap (G-DMA).
HC: no static LG-client HC master on main (G-HC); no hc_* / hc_eng instances emitted.
VM STATUS: vm_status4 fully driven by v15 status edges (restated); vmstat and the calendars' status outputs have no consumer.
notes.sm_vm: X-LOAD TOPOLOGY: one static x-load cluster per quadrant (4 total), flattened from ot_hgi_sm_xload_static_cl2 (wires-only parent) into its hardened leaves (ctl, bfq x4, aq_tree13 x2, bdring = 8 instances/quadrant, 32 total). Reasons: each quadrant VM has exactly ONE read group 2 ("SM xload", 8 banks x 17 b rq / 257 b rr = the cl2 rq/rr widths), and the SM x-store write has no SM-select (xw_grp = beat), so the quadrant x vector is written once and broadcast to its 8 SMs (v14 "x written once / quadrant x copy"). RD_LAT=6 = ot_vms_bank_static rq->rr (n+6) with ZERO die-level stages between hb_vms_<q> banks and xl_<q>_ctl: if placement needs relays on rq/rr, RD_LAT must grow (compiler model tools/hbm_sm_xload_static_timing.py) -- DOUBT, no slot granted yet (compact660_v5 has no x-load slot). xw broadcast fan-out: 2063 b x 8 SMs from one ctl per quadrant spans the SM rows (6.6 mm slots) -> die relays/feedthrough on xw will be needed; the static schedule tolerates fixed stages only if every SM sees the same count (SM front deskew) -- DOUBT for H-SM/H-DIE. eb3e3e94a IS an ancestor of HEAD: attention SM (ot_hbm_accel_smh_attn, kv_desc) is on main but not bindable (G-SMVM-KVDESC). Bank strap masters are leaves inside hb_vms (G-SMVM-STRAP), nothing at die level. fp4 of the quantisers declared as strap (format mode, owner composition tie) -- coordinator may reclassify. Coordinator-owned SM ports (clk/rst_n/command/packet/expected_request) untouched; every SM input bit of xw_* is driven here.
notes.su_sfu: SU: 16 x ot_hbm_su_static_pgslice + 4 x ot_hbm_su_static_qcore lifted 1:1 from ot_hbm_su_static_quarter/top (QID SW0 SE1 NW2 NE3 = v15 hb_su QIDs). Params = the only whole-SU proof with the die RF_RELAY: MR1 multirate d9507c056 (receipt results/arch/hbm_su_f2_static_1014/multirate_native_d9507c056: MULTIRATE=1, MLAT=4, ALAT=3, LEAF=1, RF_RELAY=36, RR10/WR7). DOUBT: the RTL default is still MULTIRATE=0/MLAT=3/LEAF=0 (su_multirate_top_contract.json default_parameter 0, candidate 1); MULTIRATE=1 is required by the v7 die clocking (slices serial 900 + pg_clk stream 1200). H-SU branch claude/hsu-k0r2-1705 (PIN_REG lane, programme 7116->7120) is NOT on main and not used. Command source: ot_hbm_su_programme (serial plane, 9688-bit line = 4 x {control1742,vmr240,vmw312,rf54,red74}, MSB->LSB, so quarter q red_cmd=[q*2422+0,+74), rf_rd=[+74,+128), vmw=[+128,+440), vmr=[+440,+680), control=[+680,+2422)); one central instance fans 9688 bits to all four quadrants -- it has NO die slot and its fixed S+4 timing assumes a direct registered boundary, so any die relay on that fan-out must be absorbed by the compiler epoch (H-SU/H-DIE). The stream programme plane (64-bit VM calendar cal_rd/cal_wr) belongs to the VM/calendar region, not here. Quarter glue: red_sel is pure wiring (bound as bit-slice edges); rf_drain_now (AND) and the relay head valid (red_sv&&red_tag[8], AND) have no die home -> gaps G-SU-DRAIN-NOW-*, G-SU-RFR-VALID-*. RF relays: 16 routes x 36 = 576 x hbfd_rly_48_<flow> (one register stage each, async active-low clear of ALL 48 bits from rs; the top's st_v reset is a subset, data reset is harmless); ck = clk_relay[w] = serial, rs = rst_n. PAD: stage 0 i[41:48] tied 0 (straps), last-stage o[41:48] open; logical width 41 = {v, addr8, data32} at bits 40, 39:32, 31:0. Flow per stage from su_rf_relays_v7 home deltas (next-home direction). SFU: RTL on main says the core IS ot_hgi_sfu_scheduled_engine with LG_PATH=1+R (ot_hgi_sfu_split_engine is a composition with no own logic; leaves+relays are die instances; H-SU 72130e7c9, Qswiglu exact at R=0/R=9). R=11 per sfu_core_request_v7 (LG_PATH 12; the compiler's SFU_LG_PATH IO calendar must be regenerated for 12 -- only R=9 was benched). SFU relays use the DEDUPE standard hbfd_rly_624 (fwd 596 b = rq34+wq562, bwd 516 b = rr514+done2) x 11 stages x 2 directions x 16 pairs = 352; PAD fwd 28 b, bwd 108 b. SFU core has NO slot (PROPOSED strip; H-SM must shrink SM rows) and the relay stages have no homes -> placement open (H-DIE). SFU rst_lane_n/rst_map_n are given as stream resets (v15 listed them under the loader/CP owner; if a programme-controlled lane reset is intended they move into G-SFU-LOADER). Faults: pgslice/qcore/sfucore fault outputs unconsumed (no die status aggregator in this region). hb_argmax.am_stream gap is recorded here per H-SU ownership (instance is the coordinator's).
